title: MHZ Ship Builder - manufacturers pack
description: Schema for data/shapes/manufacturers.json. Legible style presets keyed by snake_case manufacturer id; each narrows one or more families from data/shapes/families.json. Enforced by tools/ship_validate_data.gd, which additionally checks that every 'families' key resolves to a real family id and that every narrowed param key and disabled op exists on that family - checks a standalone JSON Schema cannot express.

narrow_range.description: A subset of a family's param_range for this param. Any of min/max/default may be given; a validator cross-checks against the family's own range and must reject a wider bound.

description.description: Who this company is, what their hulls look like, founding era, who buys from them. Not disguised randomness - a legible house style.

families.description: family_id -> narrowing. A missing family entry means 'family defaults, unrestricted'. Every key here must resolve to a real families.json id (checked by the validator tool, not by this schema).
